name: imprint-details
title: Imprint details
description: The legal entity facts a site is expected to show: name, address, register and VAT numbers, who represents it, how to reach it.
docs: Every field of entity is optional, and a field you leave out leaves no dash behind. Add more titled lists (editorial responsibility, a data protection officer) with sections. Give title to use it as the whole page; without it the groups start at headingLevel. Pass labels to translate the headings and terms, for example Impressum for a German site.
